subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: monthly token volume + peak TPS
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-18T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: monthly token volume + peak TPS

Hi Julia —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of qualification questions so we can size cost/contracting options: 

Summary from our discussion:
- Primary workload: clinical note generation + summarization for pilot customers (inference-only, no fine-tuning).
- Expected monthly token volume: you mentioned a ballpark range on the call; can you confirm a target range (low / expected / high)?
- Peak TPS: we discussed spikes when batch imports finish — can you confirm peak requests/sec and whether those are short bursts (~30–120s) or sustained?
- Target unit economics: you mentioned a budget target in $/1M tokens; please confirm your target and any hard cap on monthly spend.

High level next steps from our side:
1) If you can confirm monthly token ranges + peak TPS, we’ll produce a hosted API ballpark cost and a brief SOW (attached draft).
2) If usage is steady and >~1B tokens/mo or you need guaranteed latency, we’ll include Dedicated sizing as an option.
3) Rishi will include recommended autoscaling & caching knobs to hit your target $/1M token economics.

Suggested questions to confirm on your side: approx avg tokens per request, % of requests that are streaming vs non-streaming, and any retention/compliance constraints.

To speed things up, I’ve attached a simple usage workbook — feel free to drop numbers in and send back.

Ballpark assumptions we’d use to provide an initial hosted estimate (subject to confirmation):
- Unit price target: ~$25–35 per 1M tokens (volume discounts available)
- Example: 600M tokens/mo => ~ $15k–21k/mo at that unit range (before discounts).
- Peak TPS headroom: we plan for ~20–30% headroom above your reported peak; if you expect sustained >120 TPS we’d recommend Dedicated or a reserved burst policy.

Please reply with the 3 numbers (low/expected/high token/mo) and peak TPS (and whether bursts are short or sustained) and we’ll turn around a price example + SOW.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

Numbers (low / expected / high) monthly tokens:
- Low: 300M tokens/mo (pilot, limited rollout)
- Expected: 600M tokens/mo (multi-customer pilot)
- High: 1.1B tokens/mo (full rollout into 3 hospitals)

Avg tokens per request: ~700 tokens (generation + short summary + metadata)
Percent streaming: ~20% (most calls are non-streaming generation)
Peak TPS:~150 TPS for short bursts (30–90s) during end-of-day batch processing; sustained peak we expect closer to 40–50 TPS during business hours.
Budget target: we’re aiming for ~$20k–30k/month for hosted costs initially; target unit economics is about $30 / 1M tokens or lower if possible.

Procurement notes (cc’d): we’ll need SOC2 report and a statement of data handling; procurement will confirm contracting timeline once we have an SOW and ballpark PO number.

I’ve filled out the usage workbook and attached it (usage-estimates.xlsx). Let me know if you need anything else.

—Julia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-18T20:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: monthly token volume + peak TPS

Perfect — thanks for the detail, Julia. Based on your expected case (600M tokens/mo, avg 700 tokens/request, short bursts to 150 TPS) here are two hosted pricing ballparks and a recommendation: 

Option A — Hosted API (self-serve + committed volume discount):
- List unit price (no commit): $45 / 1M tokens
- Committed discount band (600M/mo): ~$30 / 1M tokens (we can propose this formally in an MRC/commit)
- Example monthly cost (at $30 / 1M): 600M -> $18,000/mo
- Notes: short 150 TPS bursts are OK; we’ll recommend prefix caching and request batching to lower unit cost.

Option B — Dedicated (reserved capacity) — recommended if you want strict latency SLOs and predictable unit economics:
- One-time onboarding + monthly reserved capacity (depends on required sustained TPS).
- Near-linear lower unit price at scale; able to sustain 150 TPS spikes without cross-tenant throttling.

Additional notes: 
- With caching + batching optimizations we typically see 15–30% token reduction for summarization-heavy loads (could bring effective cost down).
- If $20k–30k/mo is your target, the hosted committed price at ~$30/1M on 600M tokens sits in the middle of that band (~$18k). If you target $20k hard minimum spend, we can structure a committed tier to meet that.

Attached is a SOW draft and I’ve cc’d Rishi (solutions) and Logan (CS) to help with the technical sizing for burst tolerance and a short runbook for caching. Rishi — can you suggest which autoscale policy + cache TTL we should recommend for their workload? Logan — can you confirm onboarding timeline (2–3 weeks) and any added runbook items for procurement?

Next steps:
- Rishi & Logan to confirm technical config and timeline for the SOW.
- I’ll turn this ballpark into a formal pricing slide and a redline-able SOW (SOW-draft.pdf attached) for procurement.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
